[EN] Have we met before? I see so many people in this job, it's hard to remember...

Wait, don't go! I was wondering, maybe, if you want to buy some crystals? I'm told they're just the thing to avoid an untimely and messy death.
[ES] ¿Nos hemos visto antes? Veo a tanta gente en este trabajo que es difícil recordar...

¡Espera, no te vayas! Me preguntaba si tal vez quieras comprar algunos Crystal. Me dicen que son justo lo necesario para evitar una muerte prematura y sangrienta.
